description: Find where a domain ranks in Google's organic results for a keyword, in a country and on a device, right now. Prefer it over google_search when only one site matters: it returns that site's best position and every other position, or a note that the site is outside the checked depth. A subdomain counts as the domain: example.com also matches blog.example.com. Billed like google_search, per started 10 results of depth (https://serper.live/pricing).

country.description: Two-letter code of the market to search in, e.g. "US", "GB", "DE", "FR", "TR": Google sees a visitor from this country. Call list_countries for the markets that are open right now.

depth.description: How many organic results to check, 1–100. Default: 10. Use 30 or more to see positions beyond the first page.

device.description: Browser persona Google sees. Desktop and mobile rankings often differ. Default: desktop.

domain.description: Domain to look for, e.g. "example.com". Scheme, path and a leading www are ignored.

language.description: Google interface language (hl), e.g. "en", "de", "fr", "uk". Defaults to the language of the country; the market itself is set by country.

query.description: Search keyword, exactly as a person would type it into Google.

name: domain_position
title: Domain position in Google
